module_name: Behavior and Engagement Analytics: Prediction, Temporal Patterns, Churn
module_description: Module 21 moves from content to behavior: predicting engagement (likes/shares/comments/saves) from content features, temporal patterns (posting cadence, time-of-day effects, seasonality), session/watch behavior for video, and churn/follower-growth modeling. It teaches feature engineering from social data and honest evaluation with temporal splits to avoid leakage.
core_concepts: Engagement prediction from content and context features
learning_outcomes: C3 Build an engagement predictor and evaluate it honestly
C4 Analyze temporal behavior patterns in a corpus
C5 Interpret behavioral findings for content strategy
methods_models: Feature engineering (text stats, posting time, hashtags, author history), gradient boosting / regression, time-series features, survival analysis for retention
evaluation_metrics: MAE/RMSE for engagement counts, Spearman for ranking, AUC for churn, temporal-split validation (no shuffle)
pitfalls_limitations: Leakage from using future information, engagement ratios confounded by platform distribution, popularity bias, small-sample overfitting, causal overreach (engagement != attitude)
tools_stack: pandas, scikit-learn, lightgbm/xgboost, statsmodels, river (streaming optional)
commercial_platforms: Comparison with native analytics dashboards (TikTok Studio, YouTube Studio) metrics definitions
tools_access_cost: Free (open-source); no vendor access needed for native metric definitions
lab_activities: Predict next-day engagement for a creator corpus; analyze watch-time curves for a video sample
datasets_apis: Public engagement datasets (Kaggle-style) or collected author-level logs
assessment_methods: Lab submission plus a short strategy recommendation memo; graded on metric validity and quality of reasoning
data_collection_workflow: Collect short-video metadata and media -> transcribe/OCR -> extract retention and engagement features -> normalise by follower base -> analyse and report
textbooks: Feature-engineering practice books (e.g. Zheng, Feature Engineering for Machine Learning)
Silge & Robinson, Text Mining with R, ch. 7
key_papers: 2024-2026 papers on short-video watch-time prediction and on engagement metrics in algorithmic feeds
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: watch time and completion replaced like-count as the core video metric; first-party consented data replaced third-party tracking in measurement practice
industry_relevance: Directly used in short-form content strategy, creator-marketing measurement, and social-commerce analytics teams; the metrics in this module (watch time, completion, saves, CTR via video) are the same KPIs agencies report to clients.
localization_context: Taught against the Indonesian short-video and live-commerce ecosystem (TikTok Shop, live shopping sessions, Shopee/Tokopedia live), which has different content formats and monetization mechanics from the US market.
ethics_regulation: Disclosure of paid partnerships, sponsored content and affiliate links; UU PDP and platform rules on scraping engagement data; caution when profiling creators and audiences from public metrics.
case_study_scenarios: What content features predict saves and shares for a local creator's posts?
